scope_guards: The 2026 digital-service transition is routing evidence and not an appeal decision.
Existing ACP cases and new digital cases are not duplicates merely because two service surfaces remain visible.
The rolling five-year casework database is selected decision coverage rather than a complete all-time appeal register.
A missing case or blank field is not interpreted as no appeal or a negative answer.
An exact planning application, appeal reference, site and decision must be bound before using an appeal outcome.
Search and comment functionality does not itself establish a lodged, valid or decided appeal.
Aggregate three-in-ten allowance and approximately 23,000 homes are not candidate probabilities or capacities.
No score or promotion is written without exact case binding, current decision, title relation and executed overlays.
